name: Kurt
description: Prince of the kingdom of Ast. Noble and kindhearted. Vows to take back and rebuild the kingdom.

name: Gotthold
description: Commander of the knights of the kingdom of Ast. His loyalty to the kingdom earned him the title of "the Shield."

name: Carina
description: Brave and exuberant knight of the kingdom of Ast. Is also known as "the Bull."

name: Alberta
description: A calm and prudent knight of the kingdom of Ast. Sometimes she is known as "the Panther."

name: Zasha
description: Mercenary of the kingdom of Ast, shrouded in silence and mystery. His sister perished during the war.

name: Rose
description: Princess of the kingdom of Holtz. Has a head full of dreams and heart full of love for her fiancé, Prince Kurt.

name: Sai
description: Retainer to the light goddess Naga. Generous but soft-spoken individual and brother of Shea, who is also a retainer to Naga.

name: Shea
description: Retainer to the light goddess Naga. Pure of heart and innocent, she is the sister of Sai, who is also a retainer to Naga.

name: Skoll
description: Retainer, along with his sister Hati, to Fenris, the goddess of shadows. Believes everyone should embrace their inner beast.

name: Hati
description: Retainer to shadow goddess Fenris. Often gets lost in her own thoughts. Sister to Skoll, who is a retainer to the same goddess.

name: Tamamo
description: Retainer to Kyubi, the goddess of illusion. Delights in deceiving others. Introverted sister of Uka, who is a retainer to the same goddess.

name: Dimitri
description: Disciple of shadow goddess Fenris. Wishes for a world in which the weak are not oppressed. Cannot recall his past or who he is.

name: Lyn
description: Servant of the Light Goddess Naga. Firm and righteous, she cannot remember who she is nor her past.

name: Bartolomeus
description: Vicious leader of a band of ravaging bandits. Attacks and pillages villages to aid the empire's invasion. Ostensibly the captain of an imperial squad that doesn't actually exist.

name: Joachim
description: A kind boy from a cold village in the northern mountains, he rarely seeks conflict. He's a descendant of wolves from the bloodline of Fenris.

name: Corrin
description: Mysterious disciple traveling the land. While she doesn't stay in any one place for long, everyone who meets her is charmed.

name: Micaela
description: Kindly mother figure running an orphanage in a mountain village. Raises children who have lost their parents as if they were her own.

name: Veronica
description: Disciple of Fenris, the goddess of shadows. A loner who has trouble relating to others. Cannot remember her past or who she is.

name: Estel
description: Close childhood friend of Joachim. Acts a bit childish but has a powerful sense of justice. Her strength and skill as a hunter make her invaluable to the orphanage.

name: Ike
description: A mercenary leader and soldier who takes on jobs for little pay. He often lives in poverty and doesn't come off as all that mercenary.

name: Erma
description: A knight from the Holy Kingdom of Tournu, who carries out justice with her lance. Serves as Yuni's guard.

name: Edelgard
description: A disciple serving the shadow who wants to reshape the world. To fulfill that wish, she will not hesitate to point her axe at a god.

name: Yuni
description: Retainer to Divine Dragon Naga. On a personal quest to find and defeat disciples of shadow rather than working with other retainers.

name: Ephraim
description: Wandering mercenary who longs for battle. Accepts missions as a disciple of shadow, but mostly acts as a free agent.

name: Uka
description: Retainer to Kyubi, the goddess of illusion. Cheerful and friendly brother of Tamamo, who is a retainer to the same goddess.

name: Yunaka
description: Mysterious and elusive, she keeps to herself. Lively when talking to others, with a unique manner of speech. She sometimes doubts her memory.

name: Rusty
description: A highly skilled mercenary working with Notia's Monster Watch. He is said to be descended from one of the 12 slain royal families.

name: Ananke
description: A former forest-dweller and healer, working with Notia's Monster Watch. She is energetic and cheerful, and popular at the academy.

name: Robin
description: A disciple and tactician for a vigilante group. Aware of another personality within her, but tries to strategize for the sake of everyone without becoming pessimistic.

name: Hanya
description: A member of Notia's Monster Watch. Although she is a princess, she chose to join the Watch. She is quite skilled with a lance.

name: Claude
description: A disciple allied to no specific faction. Open-minded and sociable, he wishes for a world built upon mutual respect.

name: Eugene
description: A member of Notia's Monster Watch. A proud knight from a prestigious noble family, and a childhood friend of Hanya.

name: Tiki
description: A childlike disciple of light who trusts that her goddess will lead the world to a better place. Has nightmares in which she turns into a violent dragon.

name: Perenna
description: A professor at the academy and first-rate magic user who helps train the Monster Watch. Firm yet kind, she is adored by her students.

name: Celica
description: A disciple of light who desires peace. Deeply faithful, yet fears how much power the shadow has over the soul.

name: Yuyo
description: A member of Notia's Monster Watch. A lithe scout with many younger siblings and a strong work ethic.

name: Roy
description: A decisive yet humble light disciple. People are drawn to his character. His many hardships fuel his growth.

name: Leda
description: Vihuela master, bard, and shadow disciple, the Siren of the Six-String holds a deep hatred for a certain foe.

name: Dietrich
description: A roaming disciple of shadow who seeks pleasure in battle—an urge even the gods cannot temper.

name: Black Knight
description: A disciple of shadow who wanders the land like a phantom, hoping to encounter a worthy foe.

name: Magnus
description: The captain of a mercenary band tasked with the protection of Holtz. He fights to repay Rose's kindness.

name: Bernadetta
description: A homebody who lives in seclusion. You may gain her trust, but good luck convincing her to come outside.
